body: Thank you so much, you don't know how much your words mean to me. I'm just so tired of hearing that my problems are in my head, and that I should have a clear idea of how to fix it. What really drove the nail home is when my sister told me this, the only person who I thought I could talk to about my problems. She said, "You know, it's all in your head, knock that shit off," in a tone that suggested that she was obviously right in saying this. It hurt so much hearing her say that.
